requirementMember.description: One FR, NFR or RULE member with exact derivation lineage and verification surface references.

derivation.description: Derivation source references. prdIntentRefs are required for every kind (reverse edges 0054/0057/0060). ucScenarioRefs/ucTerminalBranchRefs carry the scenario lineage when scenario-derived or scenario-local (edges 0055/0056/0058/0061); a scenario-derived FR must also bind terminal branches. sourceConstraintRefs carry the cross-cutting direct lineage (edges 0059/0062).

verificationSurfaceRefs.description: The verification surfaces by which this requirement will be verified; resolved against the exact accepted verification-surface id set.

description: FRF-WP03 requirements bundle payload contract (derive-system-requirements desk). FR/NFR/RULE members derive from exact accepted PRD and UC material: every member binds exact PRD intent; scenario-derived FRs bind UC scenario AND terminal-branch identities; cross-cutting NFR/RULE may bind source constraints directly and are never forced into a fictional scenario. The bundle pins the accepted PRD/UC revisions it derives from. Payload contract only.

prdRevisionRef.description: The exact accepted PRD revision this bundle derives from.

ucRevisionRef.description: The exact accepted UC revision (required whenever any member cites UC material).
